technology_name: A METHOD FOR FABRICATING BIOMASS-DERIVED ELECTRODES FOR ELECTROCHEMICAL ADVANCED OXIDATION PROCESSES
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Advanced oxidation electrodes relying on noble platinum-group coatings require cost-prohibitive processing steps and experience early thermal degradation limits.
description: A low-temperature pyrolysis manufacturing process to transform organic wood biomass waste streams (such as raw teak wood variants) into durable, high-efficiency graphite-structured carbon electrodes for electrochemical oxidation.
applications: Industrial toxic chemical treatment plants, pharmaceutical effluent degradation units, landfill leachate mitigation filters, and commercial water purifiers.
secondary_sector: Water, Environment & Waste Management, Energy, Climate & Sustainability
